title: Keryx harness capability matrix
description: Generated from the unified harness adapter registry (W5). Each entry states, for one harness, its overall support state and the per-surface capability facts backing that state. Never hand-authored: `keryx integrations matrix [--check]` regenerates and validates this artifact against the live registry.

version.description: Schema/content version of this matrix artifact, e.g. "0.1.0".

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the generation run that produced this artifact.

harnesses.description: One entry per registered harness adapter.

harnessId.description: Canonical harness id (W5-multi-harness.md, Design → Target matrix).

adapterKind.description: How enforcement reaches this harness: a command written into the harness's own hook config, Keryx running as the agent itself (e.g. ACP), or no runtime enforcement at all.

state.description: native = direct, verified, actively-installing/validating surface. adapter = works through a thin bridge or experimental-confidence host hook. instruction-only = a file is written/read but nothing decides anything. unsupported = no known mechanism; registered only for a precise CLI message.

reason.description: One-line, source-backed reason this surface is unavailable for this harness (e.g. "exit-code only hooks; no documented field injects context").

confidence.description: Overall confidence for this harness's entry. An entry with state "native" must be "verified".

surfaces_supported.description: Surface flags this harness has at `state` or better, each with the settings file (if any) it is installed into.

surfaces_unsupported.description: Surface flags explicitly not available for this harness, each with a stated reason.

install_command.description: The `keryx integrations install --runtime <id> ...` invocation for this harness.

verification_command.description: The `keryx integrations doctor --runtime <id>` invocation that proves the install is live.

risk_notes.description: Free text describing known risk/uncertainty. Required non-empty whenever confidence is "experimental".

last_verified.description: ISO date the source_docs were last actually read/confirmed.

source_docs.description: Citations backing this entry's claims: public standard/doc URLs or in-repo file paths. Must be non-empty for any entry with state "native".

settingsFile.description: Relative path of the settings file this surface installs into, when applicable (absent for policy-travels-with-agent surfaces like Zed's ACP block surface).
